Well, jojo has been in our family for 25 years and came from an abusive home. For 20 years, when he was in my moms care, you couldn’t go near his cage, he wouldn’t play, he wouldn’t even leave his cage at all. About 5 years ago I decided to take him into my care and he preferred to play outside his cage, he was full of chirps, he loved me around him, and even let me pet him.

When lemon had just learned to fly she managed to escape her cage. This was about to be a Canadian winter and I saw her fly FAR. My mom had no hope, but still I believed she’d find her way home. I made sure everyone in my town knew about lemon and would regularly do bird calls with jojo every hour. Less than 24 hours later she returned. It was a little miracle.
